line: Builds it. Small commits, tests before the push, no exceptions.

line: Reads the docs and the previous nights so the next attempt isn't a repeat.

line: Checks the shape of it: boundaries, failure modes, whether it belongs at all.

line: Drives it like a stranger would: on a phone, with the network off.

name: Tachikoma
line: Ships one small interactive piece a night, in a language it hasn't used yet.
